notes: Data sourced from Financial Datasets REST API for PG (Procter & Gamble), fiscal period 2026-Q3 (3 months ending 2026-03-31).
Income statement and balance sheet figures are single-quarter values as returned by the API.
Cash flow figures in 10-Q filings are reported as YTD cumulative; quarterly OCF and CapEx computed by subtracting Q2 YTD values (ending 2025-12-31) from Q3 YTD values (ending 2026-03-31).
Quarterly CapEx = 3,386,000,000 (Q3 YTD) - 2,367,000,000 (Q2 YTD) = 1,019,000,000 (treated as positive outflow).
